title: A more personal, polished journey.
changes: A private Journal for written, voice, and signed-in image notes; image notes are resized and compressed before secure Firestore storage.
A clearer mobile Timeline with a compact-on-scroll header, cleaner Calendar Sources control, icon-only Today jump, and reliable swipe browsing in previews.
Reference calendar cards now stay lighter in the stream while their complete details remain available in preview.

title: Thoughtful reminders. Smoother updates.
changes: A local notification inbox for event, task, and project reminders, with quiet hours and optional phone notifications.
Clear update checks, safe restarts, and release notes without touching your saved plans.
Touch-aware tablet scaling, adaptive navigation, Light/Dark/Auto, and offline installation.

title: A little structure. A lot of possibility.
changes: Connected Timeline, Calendar, Tasks, Projects, and Journal pages with local browser persistence.
Monthly artwork, account access, Profile Settings, and credential-free workspace exports.
